items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: we had a band and Tomless Jefferson playing trumpet where one would get off quick playing piano and Tomless Jefferson would get back on horn

ctx.x: But you know, if Morgan was playing with his brass band he could double on piano. That's right. Just like Picks can double. Well, we used to go to, when we were playing at the Hop Club in Morgan City, we had a band

and Tomless Jefferson playing trumpet where one would get off quick playing piano and Tomless Jefferson would get back on horn and Al would get on piano. Yeah, I've never heard Jefferson play the album.
He's good, too. Everyone says he's very good. He's good. So you didn't have many favorite banjo players?
